notes.note: The four helpers in lib/dialer/scope.ts are unexercised by any automated check: this repo has no unit runner, and no /api/dialer/** route or seeded caller profile reaches them yet, so pnpm test:static only proves types and import boundaries.

requireDialerCaller refuses a missing or inactive profile with 403, not 404, so a denial-sweep row for a caller route must choose a non-owning role that actually holds a caller profile rather than the default preacher.
The paging loop in lib/dialer/scope.ts duplicates the unexported collectPagedRows in lib/supabase/manage.ts; AD-16's single shared pager still needs extracting when manage.ts is next in scope.
